records.sql: SELECT league FROM mlb GROUP BY league ORDER BY league
SELECT pos FROM mlb GROUP BY pos ORDER BY pos
SELECT yr FROM mlb GROUP BY yr, yr ORDER BY yr

SELECT MAX(bat_avg), MIN(bat_avg), MAX(babip), MIN(babip), MAX(iso_val), MIN(iso_val), MAX(woba), MIN(woba), league, pos, yr FROM mlb WHERE league='PCL' AND pos='Center Fielder' AND yr=2015 GROUP BY league,pos,yr,yr

SELECT league, CASE WHEN pos LIKE '% Fielder' THEN 'outfield' ELSE 'other' END AS tag, COUNT(*) FROM mlb GROUP BY league, CASE WHEN pos LIKE '% Fielder' THEN 'outfield' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY league, tag

SELECT league, CASE WHEN pos LIKE '% Fielder' THEN 'outfield' ELSE 'other' END AS tag, SUM(n) FROM (SELECT league,pos,COUNT(*) AS n FROM mlb GROUP BY league,pos) g GROUP BY league, CASE WHEN pos LIKE '% Fielder' THEN 'outfield' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY league, tag
